Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — Harbor Community College has been piloting Redwood’s hosted API for our undergraduate AI curriculum this fall. We started with the PLG free tier credits and the students and CS faculty have been getting good value out of it.

We’re coming up against the self-serve cap: the class needs an additional 150k generation tokens to finish their final projects and run instructor evaluations. This is for a single course (CS 401) across ~120 students and will be used for classroom demos, grading rubrics, and a small set of automated tutoring prompts.

Request: can Redwood issue a one-time trial/top-up for 150,000 generation tokens or provide a short trial extension through 2027-01-31 so we can complete grading? We’re a non-profit educational institution and this would help finalize our adoption decision. If you need any paperwork, I can loop in procurement.

Thanks — I can be flexible with timing for a quick call this week if needed.

Best,
